params.place: a rooftop at dusk, the flat Starlink dish on its mast under a darkening sky

an arrow rises straight up from it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: When they all send at the same instant, their ripples add up into one strong wave, heading straight up.

params.place: the same row, the timing bars over the antennas starting to step

moments.what: the flat ripples rising

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Now make each antenna fire a little later than the one beside it.

params.place: the row of antennas, each one now a pair of clapping hands

the arrow leans off to the side

params.place: the ripple sheet, the wave front now slanted

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So what happens to the wave? The ripples still add up, but now the wave front tilts, and the beam leans over toward the late side.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Change the delays, and the beam swings across the sky. Nothing turns. Nothing moves. It's aiming by timing.
